sql:
SELECT pc.ProductCategoryName,
       sumIf(sp.Amount, sp.ScenarioKey = 1) AS ActualSales,
       sumIf(sp.Amount, sp.ScenarioKey = 2) AS BudgetSales,
       sumIf(sp.Amount, sp.ScenarioKey = 1) - sumIf(sp.Amount, sp.ScenarioKey = 2) AS Variance,
       (sumIf(sp.Amount, sp.ScenarioKey = 1) - sumIf(sp.Amount, sp.ScenarioKey = 2)) * 100.0
           / nullif(sumIf(sp.Amount, sp.ScenarioKey = 2), 0) AS VariancePct
FROM retail.FactStrategyPlan sp
JOIN retail.DimProductCategory pc ON pc.ProductCategoryKey = sp.ProductCategoryKey
WHERE sp.AccountKey = 50
  AND sp.ScenarioKey IN (1, 2)
  AND toYear(sp.DateKey) = 2009
GROUP BY pc.ProductCategoryName
ORDER BY ActualSales DESC
